cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Dr. And Mrs. Charles M. Henry, Toccoa, Georgia, 1947; Descended in family; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 5584, lot no. 320, 28 May 1987; Private collection, Tokyo, Japan, 1987; Christie's, New York, NY, sale no. 8408, lot no. 160, 23 May 1996 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Sold by Downtown Gallery." Backing inscription dates 1924. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1921. Dated 1922 on basis of inclusion in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence; pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription 1, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Green Leaves

description: Clusters of green leaves fill the canvas. Thin brown branches stretch diagonally across the composition, and three small red berries are visible on the upper left. The leaves seem to fade slightly into the abstract blue, green, and yellow background.
title: Green Leaves
